name: ROASTED PINE NUT HUMMUS
ingredientsText: ORGANIC CHICKPEAS, WATER, ORGANIC SESAME TAHINI, ORGANIC SUNFLOWER OIL, ORGANIC LEMON JUICE, ORGANIC GARLIC, SEA SALT, ORGANIC CUMIN. notes: OFF tags miss the pine nuts; pine nut is one of the 12 tree nuts.
